name: Intellectual Property Law for Business
scope: Programma completo (nessun parziale). Letture: WIPO Intellectual Property Handbook (capitoli/pagine indicati per lezione). Bonus: certificato EUIPO +1,5, EPO +3 (max 3), scadenza inizio dicembre.

exam.label: Esame scritto (sessione gennaio/febbraio — data da confermare)
exam.format: Esame scritto, corretto da 4 correttori; stessa difficoltà a ogni appello.

topics.title: L1 Course introduction: strategic role of IP, WIPO, Paris Convention, TRIPS
L2 The multifaceted nature of copyright (Berne, WCT, Rome)
L3 Copyright on the Internet: communication to the public, platform liability (DSM art. 17)
L4 Copyright enforcement and remedies; industrial design
L5 AI and copyright: authorship, training, TDM exceptions
L6 Industrial design & licensing as a business tool
L7 Copyright, design, sustainability and new business models
L8 Trademarks as an innovation tool
L9 Trademarks I: requirements, distinctiveness, registration routes
L10 Trademarks II: EUTM, Madrid, GIs, classifications (guest: Boss case)
L11 Patents I: laws, treaties, patentability requirements
L12 Patents II: novelty, inventive step, PCT, US reforms
L13 Patents III: European patent system, regional systems, CII (guest EPO)
L14 Circulation of IPRs I: technology transfer, licensing
L15 Circulation of IPRs II: EU safe harbor, SEP & FRAND
L16 Licensing in practice; antitrust and essential facilities
L17 International trade and IP: TRIPS, FTAs
L18 Forced licensing in technology transfer (guest Deloitte)
